title: Combinations Problem

content.problemStatement:
You receive two integers `n` and `k`, output *all possible combinations of* `k` *numbers chosen from the range* `[1, n]`.

You may output the answer in **any order**.
content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of all arguments, e.g. [arg1, arg2, ...]

sampleTestCases.explanation: For this input, applying the required rules of Combinations produces [[1,2],[1,3],[1,4],[2,3],[2,4],[3,4]].
For this input, applying the required rules of Combinations produces [[1]].

hidden.label: MAX constraint stress: peak output count
